1. Data Controller

The data controller of the personal data collected through BikeMaster is:

• Company: BikeMaster Team
• Email: privacy@bikemaster.app

2. Types of Data Collected

Through the use of BikeMaster, we collect the following categories of data:

• Navigation data: IP address, browser type, operating system, log data
• User personal data: name, email, age, weight, height, medical data voluntarily provided in the athlete profile
• GPS and physical activity data: geographic coordinates, route track, speed, altitude, heart rate, power, cadence, distance, elevation
• Geolocation data: real-time position during GPS tracking from phone
• Data from external services: activity data from Strava, Garmin Connect, Google Fit (only if authorized by the user)
• Access credentials: username and password (stored in encrypted form)

3. Purposes of Processing

Personal data is processed for the following purposes:

• Provide and maintain the BikeMaster service
• Improve user experience and develop new features
• Perform analytics and generate statistics
• Send service-related notifications
• Ensure security and prevent fraud
